title: Slate / Edge Finder row links read as one long unlabeled string; fair price and edge values have no labels [1.3.1 Info and Relationships]
steps: Note column header row has aria-hidden="true"
expected: Each value announced with its meaning, e.g. "Fair price -580, edge +3.2%, grade B", or a list/table structure with real column headers.
actual: Whole row is a single link whose name is a concatenation like "12:42 AM Jazz @ Rockets Houston Rockets ML -476 DraftKings updated 12 min ago Logged pick -580 +3.2% B". The "Start / Best line / Fair - Edge" header is aria-hidden, so "-580" (fair) and "+3.2%" (edge) are announced with no label. Link starts with a time, not the game. Same pattern on /edges rows ("fair -580" is labelled there, the edge % is not).
evidence: DOM excerpt: -580+3.2% with no sr-only text
